title: Agent Capabilities and Tools
summary: This module defines the core capabilities and tools that AI agents can use, including mechanisms for tool discovery, execution, output processing, and lifecycle hooks. It provides foundational classes for extending agent behavior and integrating external functionalities.

nodes.label: Define Agent Capabilities
nodes.title: Abstract Capability Base
nodes.description: Provides the abstract base class for all agent capabilities, defining a comprehensive set of lifecycle hooks for agent runs, model requests, and tool interactions.

nodes.label: Specify Capability Schema
nodes.title: Capability Specification
nodes.description: A specification class used for schema generation, allowing capabilities to be defined and serialized in structured formats like YAML/JSON.

nodes.label: Define Toolset Interface
nodes.title: Abstract Toolset Base
nodes.description: Establishes the interface for collections of tools, managing their listing, argument validation, and execution within an agent's context.

nodes.label: Structure Agent Output
nodes.title: Agent Output Schema
nodes.description: Defines the expected structure and validation rules for an agent's output, supporting various data types, text processing, and tool-based outputs.

nodes.label: Manage Output Tools
nodes.title: Output Toolset
nodes.description: A specialized toolset for handling agent output types, providing tool definitions and processors for structured output validation and processing.

nodes.label: Validate Output Data
nodes.title: Output Validator
nodes.description: A generic class for validating agent output data using a user-defined function, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous validation with run context.

nodes.label: Represent Tool Signatures
nodes.title: Function Signature Definition
nodes.description: Captures the structural data of a function signature, including parameters, return type, and referenced type definitions, for rendering tool schemas.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Tool Execution
nodes.title: Tool Manager
nodes.description: Manages tool definitions, validates arguments, executes tool calls, and handles retries for an agent's run steps, integrating with capability hooks.

nodes.label: Register Lifecycle Hooks
nodes.title: Agent Hooks
nodes.description: A flexible capability for registering custom functions to intercept and modify various stages of an agent's lifecycle, including run, node, model, and tool events.

nodes.label: Extend Capability Behavior
nodes.title: Wrapper Capability
nodes.description: Allows extending or modifying the behavior of an existing capability by delegating all methods to a wrapped capability, enabling modular enhancements.

nodes.label: Extend Toolset Behavior
nodes.title: Wrapper Toolset
nodes.description: Enables modifying or extending the behavior of an existing toolset by delegating its operations to a wrapped toolset, useful for applying cross-cutting concerns.

nodes.label: Discover Deferred Tools
nodes.title: Tool Search Capability
nodes.description: Provides mechanisms for discovering tools, especially those marked for deferred loading, using native model support or local search algorithms.

nodes.label: Perform Keyword Search
nodes.title: Keyword Search Function
nodes.description: A built-in algorithm for local tool discovery, scoring tools based on keyword overlap in their names and descriptions.

nodes.label: Resolve Deferred Tool Calls
nodes.title: Deferred Tool Handler
nodes.description: Intercepts and resolves deferred tool calls (e.g., requiring approval or external execution) using a user-provided handler function, continuing the agent run automatically.

nodes.label: Provide Native/Local Tool Fallback
nodes.title: Native or Local Tool
nodes.description: A base capability for tools that can be implemented either natively by the model provider or locally with a fallback mechanism, adapting to model capabilities.

nodes.label: Execute Web Searches
nodes.title: Web Search Capability
nodes.description: Enables agents to perform web searches, utilizing native model search features or falling back to local search providers like DuckDuckGo.

nodes.label: Fetch Web Content
nodes.title: Web Fetch Capability
nodes.description: Allows agents to fetch content from URLs, using native model capabilities or a local markdownify-based fetching mechanism.

nodes.label: Integrate MCP Servers
nodes.title: MCP Server Integration
nodes.description: Connects agents to Multi-Component Platform (MCP) servers, leveraging native MCP support or falling back to local HTTP connections.

nodes.label: Integrate FastMCP Tools
nodes.title: FastMCP Toolset (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A toolset for calling tools on a local or remote FastMCP server. Deprecated in favor of `MCPToolset` for broader functionality.

nodes.label: External Toolset (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Deferred Toolset (Deprecated)
nodes.description: Deprecated alias for `ExternalToolset`, representing tools whose execution is deferred or handled externally.

nodes.label: Configure Model Reasoning
nodes.title: Thinking Capability
nodes.description: Configures the model's thinking and reasoning process, allowing adjustment of effort levels for improved decision-making.

nodes.label: Manage Thread Execution
nodes.title: Thread Executor
nodes.description: Provides a custom thread pool executor for running synchronous functions, preventing thread accumulation in long-running applications.

nodes.label: Include Tool Return Schemas
nodes.title: Tool Return Schema Inclusion
nodes.description: A capability that enables the inclusion of return type schemas for selected tools, providing models with better context for tool usage.

nodes.label: Apply Tool Metadata
nodes.title: Set Tool Metadata
nodes.description: Allows merging custom metadata key-value pairs onto selected tools, providing additional context or configuration for tool behavior.

nodes.label: Handle Agent Event Stream
nodes.title: Event Stream Processor
nodes.description: Forwards the agent's event stream to a user-provided asynchronous handler or processor, enabling real-time observation or transformation of events.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Core Abstractions
groups.description: Foundational interfaces and base classes for defining agent capabilities and toolsets.

groups.label: Agent & Tool Orchestration
groups.title: Agent & Tool Orchestration
groups.description: Components responsible for managing tool execution, handling lifecycle events, and extending agent/tool behavior.

groups.label: Output Processing
groups.title: Output Processing
groups.description: Modules dedicated to structuring, validating, and managing the agent's output.

groups.label: Tool Discovery & Deferred Handling
groups.title: Tool Discovery & Deferred Handling
groups.description: Mechanisms for dynamic tool discovery and resolving tool calls that require approval or external processing.

groups.label: Native & Local Tools
groups.title: Native & Local Tools
groups.description: Capabilities providing specific tool functionalities with adaptive native integrations and local fallbacks.

groups.label: External Tool Integrations
groups.title: External Tool Integrations
groups.description: Components for integrating with external tool platforms and servers, including deprecated FastMCP support.

groups.label: Agent Behavior Modifiers
groups.title: Agent Behavior Modifiers
groups.description: Capabilities that alter the agent's operational characteristics, such as reasoning, execution environment, and tool metadata.
